title: Province of Batangas v. Romulo
summary: The Supreme Court ordered the release of the full internal revenue allotment of local government units, striking down the practice of withholding portions of the IRA through executive issuances. The IRA must be automatically released in full without conditions.
doctrine: The internal revenue allotment is a constitutionally mandated share of LGUs in national taxes that must be automatically released without diminution. The President and the Secretary of Budget cannot impose conditions on the release of the IRA. LGUs have fiscal autonomy guaranteed by the Constitution.
fullText:
VELASCO, JR., J.:

The issue is whether the national government may withhold portions of the internal revenue allotment of local government units.

Section 6, Article X of the Constitution provides that local government units shall have a just share in the national taxes which shall be automatically released to them. The word 'automatically' means that the release should be immediate and without conditions.

The Court has consistently held that the IRA is a constitutionally mandated allocation that cannot be diminished, withheld, or subject to conditions imposed by the executive branch.
